method: Contextual review of 39 pending expressions. Keep who pays them out pending because the referent and payment relationship are unclear. Insurance definitions explain language only; policy and risk-ranking claims in the narration are not endorsed.
phrases: don't want to cover
do not want to provide insurance protection for someone or something
不愿承保
Some insurers don't want to cover unusually risky activities.
有些保险公司不愿承保风险异常高的活动。
Cover has the insurance sense, not put a lid on. Source is an imagined insurer response, not a verified quotation from a specific insurer.
go through
experience or deal with a process or difficult situation
经历；经受；处理完
I don't want to go through another lengthy approval process.
我不想再经历一次漫长的审批流程。
Source refers back to taking on the unwanted insurance risk; distinguish go through a document meaning examine it.
go through that
experience or deal with the situation just mentioned
经历那种事；处理那种情况
Moving twice was exhausting; I don't want to go through that again.
搬两次家太累了，我不想再经历一遍。
That requires an antecedent. Not a literal instruction to pass through an object; useful for stressful processes at home or work.
it does appear
it really seems to be the case, while still allowing uncertainty
看来确实似乎是……
It does appear that the update helped.
看来更新确实起了作用。
Does adds emphasis to appear, but does not remove uncertainty. Source's following the truth is is stronger rhetoric, not external verification.
the sixth worst
ranked sixth when counting from the worst end
倒数第六；从最差起排第六
The table lists the sixth worst result in the sample.
表格列出了样本中从最差起排第六的结果。
Ordinal + superlative ranks relative performance or risk. Source explicitly questions the insurance-risk ranking; teaching the phrase does not validate that statistic.
very hard to say
very difficult to determine or state confidently
很难确定；很难断言
It's very hard to say how long the repair will take.
很难确定维修需要多久。
Hard means difficult, not physically solid. Here it signals insufficient confidence in a claimed ranking.
worth the risk
valuable enough to justify accepting a possible bad outcome
值得冒这个险
Saving five minutes isn't worth the risk.
为了省五分钟，不值得冒这个险。
Worth + noun or -ing; not worth to risk. Source's negative is an evaluation from the imagined insurer's perspective, not financial advice.
a bunch of
a group or fairly large number, informally
一群；一堆；不少
I've got a bunch of emails to answer.
我有一堆邮件要回复。
Informal quantity with plural count nouns; source concerns a group of students, not a literal bouquet.
fine print
detailed terms that may be easy to overlook, often printed in small type
细则；容易忽视的小字条款
Read the fine print before you accept the offer.
接受这项优惠前，先读一读细则。
Uncountable expression. It does not mean the terms are necessarily deceptive or that the narrator's paraphrase matches every policy.
get sued
have a lawsuit brought against you
被起诉
The company could get sued over the disputed contract.
公司可能因有争议的合同而被起诉。
Conversational get-passive; being sued is not the same as being found liable. Separate unresolved essay wording in the source remains flagged.
on a weekly basis
every week or regularly each week
每周；按周
We review the schedule on a weekly basis.
我们每周检查一次日程。
More formal than weekly. Source's frequency is a narrator claim, not a measured count supplied by this review.
self-insuring
retaining and funding a risk internally rather than transferring it to an insurer
自留风险；自行承担损失风险
The report discusses the costs of self-insuring certain risks.
报告讨论了自行承担某些风险的成本。
Definition checked against the NAIC glossary. Not simply synonymous with setting up an insurance company; source's resulted in phrasing remains unresolved.
to the point where
to such an extent that a particular result occurs
到了……的地步
The folder grew to the point where we needed a better filing system.
文件夹内容越来越多，到了需要更好的归档系统的地步。
Where introduces a figurative stage or degree, not necessarily a physical location. Does not repair resulted in self-insuring in the quote.
typically don't cover
usually do not include within insurance protection
通常不在承保范围内
These plans typically don't cover every possible loss.
这些方案通常不会涵盖所有可能的损失。
Typically permits exceptions. A language example is not an interpretation of a particular policy; the source's broad claim remains attributed.
umbrella coverage
additional liability protection above primary coverage, with scope depending on the policy
伞式责任保障；基础保障之上的额外责任保障
She asked the adviser to explain umbrella coverage.
她请顾问解释伞式责任保障。

Insurance sense checked against NAIC guidance, not an ordinary umbrella or a guarantee that everything is covered. Coverage is uncountable; teach umbrella coverage or an umbrella policy, not an umbrella coverage.
no longer covered
not protected by an insurance arrangement anymore
不再受保险保障
The notice says that this activity is no longer covered.
通知称，这项活动不再属于保障范围。
No longer means a previous state has ended. The source's membership-to-coverage rule is a generalized account, not a universal rule verified here.
the minute you
as soon as you do something
你一……就……
The minute you notice an error, let me know.
你一发现错误就告诉我。
Minute is a time-trigger idiom, not a measured sixty seconds. Complete with a clause; the example is a request, not a policy rule.
you are no longer
you have stopped being in a previous state or role
你不再是……；你已不再……
You are no longer required to submit a paper copy.
你已不再需要提交纸质副本。
No longer modifies the predicate; source concerns membership status, while the teaching example illustrates a neutral requirement change.
you end up getting sued
the eventual result is that someone brings a lawsuit against you
结果你被起诉了
If the dispute escalates, you could end up getting sued.
如果纠纷升级，你可能最终被起诉。
End up + -ing describes an outcome; getting sued does not mean losing the case. Teaching example expresses possibility, not a prediction for the user.
assume the liability
take on the relevant legal responsibility
承担相关法律责任
The agreement states who will assume the liability.
协议写明由谁承担相关法律责任。
Assume means take on, not guess, in this collocation. Source's they is not expanded into a verified allocation of liability; actual responsibility depends on facts and terms.
bring your own beer
supply the beer you personally intend to drink at an event
自带啤酒
The invitation says to bring your own beer or a nonalcoholic drink.
邀请上写着自带啤酒或无酒精饮料。
Source's expansion of BYOB; other contexts may use bottle or booze. Phrase meaning does not validate event rules or encourage underage drinking.
check IDs
inspect identification documents
检查身份证件
Staff check IDs at the entrance.
工作人员在入口检查身份证件。
IDs is plural identification documents; not computer identifiers in this scene. The phrase does not establish that a check actually took place.
guest list
a list of people invited or authorized to attend an event
宾客名单
Please add her name to the guest list.
请把她的名字加到宾客名单上。
Common with on the guest list and check the guest list. Inclusion is distinct from any separate age or insurance requirement.
take off
remove something being worn
脱下；摘下
Please take off your muddy shoes at the door.
请在门口脱下沾泥的鞋子。
Removal sense for the band, not aircraft departure. Separable with pronouns: take it off, not take off it.
the second that
immediately when an event happens
一……就……；就在……的那一刻
The second that the alarm rang, everyone stopped talking.
警报一响，大家就停止了交谈。
Emphatic timing phrase, not a precise one-second measurement. Source's likely qualifies the supposed membership consequence.
you can only
you are permitted or able to do no more than the specified action
你只能……
You can only upload one file at a time.
你一次只能上传一个文件。
Only restricts what follows; source is a narrated rule about quantity, not universal permission to drink.
all else fails
all other attempted solutions do not work
其他办法都不奏效
If all else fails, we can ask for help.
如果其他办法都不奏效，我们可以寻求帮助。
Usually used inside if all else fails, not as a standalone complete instruction. Else means other options.
if all else fails
if none of the other options works
如果别的办法都不行
If all else fails, we'll reschedule the meeting.
如果别的办法都不行，我们就重新安排会议。
Introduces a fallback, followed by a main clause. The source's fallback discussion remains incomplete until subsequent paragraphs.
in which case
if the situation just described occurs, then
如果是那样的话；在这种情况下
The room may be full, in which case we'll meet online.
会议室可能满了，如果是那样，我们就在线开会。
Which refers to the preceding situation, not just a single noun. Useful for conditional consequences in scheduling and planning.
no coverage is offered
insurance protection is not provided for the stated situation
不提供保险保障
The summary says no coverage is offered for that category.
摘要称，该类别不提供保险保障。
Passive offered concerns availability of protection, not a court deciding a particular claim. Source's sweeping exclusions are not independently confirmed.
read the insurance policy
examine the document setting out insurance terms
阅读保险合同或保单条款
Please read the insurance policy before comparing the options.
比较方案前，请先阅读保险条款。
Read is /riːd/ in this instruction, not past-tense /rɛd/. The policy is the terms document, not merely an identification card.
result in
cause or lead to an outcome
导致；造成
A small error can result in a long delay.
一个小错误可能导致长时间延误。
Result in + outcome; contrast result from + cause. Source uses being sued as a passive -ing outcome.
take on fraternity cases
agree to handle legal cases involving fraternities
承接涉及兄弟会的案件
The lawyer's practice takes on fraternity cases.
这位律师的事务所承接涉及兄弟会的案件。
Take on means accept work or responsibility, not put on clothing. Also transferable as take on a project or take on a client.
throw a football around
casually toss a football back and forth
随意传着玩橄榄球
We threw a football around in the park.
我们在公园里传着橄榄球玩。
Around suggests informal repeated tossing, not throwing something around a geometric circle. American football in this campus setting; quoted restrictions remain attributed.
that makes sense
that is understandable or logically reasonable
那说得通；这样就能理解了
That makes sense; let's use the simpler option.
这样说得通，我们用更简单的方案吧。
Acknowledges an explanation, not independent factual verification. Contrast makes sense with means, which gives a definition.
one of them
one member of a previously mentioned group
其中之一
There are several options, and this is one of them.
有几种选择，这就是其中之一。
Them needs the preceding group. Source identifies fraternities as one example of organizations insurers supposedly avoid, not as all such organizations.
have a lot more in common with
share many more features with someone or something than expected or than another comparison
与……有更多共同之处
These two projects have a lot more in common with each other than we expected.
这两个项目的共同点比我们预想的多得多。
Have something in common with expresses similarity. Source's provocative comparison is rhetorical, not an assertion that the groups are identical.
third party vendor
an outside supplier rather than the organization itself
第三方供应商；外部服务商
We hired a third-party vendor to manage registration.
我们聘请了第三方服务商管理报名。
Third-party is normally hyphenated before vendor in edited writing; original unhyphenated wording is preserved. Outsourcing alone does not settle liability.
insurance policy
the contract or document specifying insurance protection and its terms
保险合同；保单条款
The insurance policy lists the exclusions.
保险合同列出了除外责任条款。
Policy here is a contract, not a general institutional rule or political position. The narrated exclusions require the actual terms to verify.
sororities
women's college social organizations, especially in the United States
大学姐妹会（复数）
Several sororities took part in the campus event.
几个姐妹会参加了校园活动。
Organization sense, not biological sisters. Compare fraternities; membership practices and particular organizations should not be inferred from this generic term.
Greek life
the fraternity and sorority system at a U.S. college
美国大学的兄弟会与姐妹会体系及其活动
The guide explains Greek life on campus.
指南介绍了校园里的兄弟会与姐妹会体系。
Greek refers to organizations' Greek-letter names, not everyday life in Greece. Clarifies the extension from fraternities to both kinds of organizations.
likely dropped
probably removed from membership or an arrangement
很可能被取消资格或除名
Members who stop renewing are likely dropped from the mailing list.
不再续订的成员很可能会被移出邮件名单。
Dropped is an informal removal sense, not physically released. Source refers to membership and says likely, not an automatic verified rule.
a band
a strip worn around part of the body, here apparently the wrist
带子；这里看来指腕带
Each guest wore a band around their wrist.
每位来宾手腕上都戴着一条带子。
Entry-control context suggests a wristband, but the PDF says band; keep that inference explicit and do not replace the quoted noun.
fellow fraternity brothers
other members of the same fraternity
同一兄弟会的其他成员
He planned the event with his fellow fraternity brothers.
他与同一兄弟会的其他成员一起策划了活动。
Fellow means sharing membership, not a male stranger, and brothers is organizational rather than biological kinship.
non-brothers
people who are not members of the fraternity in this context
非本兄弟会成员
The event was open to non-brothers as well.
那项活动也向非本会成员开放。
Contextual non- prefix negates membership, not a biological family relationship; term is informal and organization-specific.
athletic
involving sports or physical exercise
体育运动方面的
The school offers several athletic activities.
学校提供几种体育活动。
Anything athletic means activities involving sports here, not only people with a fit body. Does not validate the quoted insurance restriction.
segments: The missing women's student-organization sense is now explicitly taught; some people say preserves attribution of the ranking's scope.
Greek life is explicitly distinguished from life in Greece and connects fraternities and sororities in the preceding exchange.

Degree marker and retained-risk meaning are now taught, but resulted in versus possible resorted to remains unverified, and the following explanation may conflate self-insurance with creating an insurer.
Immediate-event marker, court-document noun and informal membership removal are all taught; likely and the generalized speaker account are preserved rather than treated as a universal policy.
Band is explained with an explicitly labeled wristband inference, take off means remove, and only limits the narrated permission to the person's own drink.
Shared organizational membership is explained; the ages contrast peer checkers with the described age-control duties, without proving compliance or noncompliance.

Casual tossing, nonmember status, sporting activity and the document reference are explicitly covered. According to the policy retains the speaker's attribution rather than certifying the restriction.
